title: Can I BEAT Martin with 1 Piece?
summary: Gauntlet vs Martin where Tony has only his king plus ONE piece against Martin's full army, stepping down each game: Nuke (wins instantly with a joke 'clears half the board' animation), Queen (win ~1:38), Rook (win ~3:26), Bishop (draw by 50-move rule ~8:31), Knight (draw ~13:10), Pawn (promotes and wins ~15:39).
rules: Player: king + one piece; Martin: full standard army.
Ladder of pieces, one per game: Nuke (queen + knightrider) -> Queen -> Rook -> Bishop -> Knight -> Pawn.
Advance to the next (weaker) piece after each game regardless of win/draw (video moved on after the bishop and knight draws).
Standard chess rules (50-move rule, insufficient material draws apply).
win_condition: Checkmate Martin with each single piece (Tony won with nuke, queen, rook, pawn; drew bishop and knight).
